params.name: filter
params.description: Filter conditions to select a subset of entities. Each condition is a key-value pair separated by = sign. Multiple conditions can be provided and are ANDed together within a filter set. Multiple filter query parameters represent OR logic between filter sets.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of simplified JSON paths to select only specific parts of the entity data structure.

params.name: order
params.description: Ordering of the result set. Format is asc:field or desc:field.

items.docs: Lists catalog entities. This endpoint is deprecated in favor of GET /entities/by-query which provides cursor-based pagination and more efficient querying.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter conditions to select a subset of entities. Format is key=value. Multiple conditions in one filter parameter are ANDed. Multiple filter parameters represent OR logic.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of simplified JSON paths to select specific parts of entity data.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of entities to return. Default is 20.

params.name: orderField
params.description: Field to order results by. Format is field,asc or field,desc.

params.name: fullTextFilter
params.description: Full-text search filter applied to entities.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the cursor value from a previous response to retrieve the next or previous batch of entities.

items.docs: Query entities with support for filtering, full-text search, ordering, and cursor-based pagination. This is the preferred endpoint for listing and searching entities.

params.name: uid
params.description: The unique identifier of the entity.

items.docs: Retrieves a single entity by its unique identifier.

params.name: uid
params.description: The unique identifier of the entity to delete.

items.docs: Deletes an entity by its unique identifier. Returns an empty 204 response whether an entity with this UID existed or not.

params.name: kind
params.description: The kind of the entity (e.g., Component, API, System).

items.docs: Retrieves a single entity by its kind, namespace, and name. This is the canonical way to fetch a specific known entity.
Retrieves the ancestry (parent chain) of an entity, showing which entities and locations were involved in producing it.
Retrieves multiple entities by their entity references in a single request. This is more efficient than making individual requests.
Triggers a refresh of a specific entity, causing the catalog to re-process its source location and update the entity data.
Validates that a passed-in entity has no errors in its schema. This can be used to check entity definitions before registering them.

params.name: facet
params.description: The field to get facets for. Can be specified multiple times for multiple facets.

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional filter to narrow the entities considered.

items.docs: Retrieves all unique values (facets) for given entity fields that match the provided filters. Useful for building filter UIs.
